en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Al Magra’a, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Distinct of His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures are distinct from Him<sup>azwj</sup>; and everything upon what the name ‘thing’ occurs, so it is a creation, apart from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from abu al-Maghra in a marfu‘ manner from Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “
Allah is distinct from His creatures and His creatures are different from Him and whatever that is called a thing is a creature except Allah.”
